1 (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path, wherein the device is configured to maintain its position during the expansion; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2 (Original): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening, wherein the opening is created using a separate surgical tool.

5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain, wherein the device is configured to minimize trauma to the surrounding tissue.

7 (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path, wherein the device is configured to maintain its position during the expansion; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers, wherein the device is configured to minimize trauma to the surrounding tissue.
